text: Aim cursor: one row key instead of selection fields scattered over entities
description: Slice 3 of 562cdb60. Replace phase.selectedAimIndex (a UI field on data-store Phase entities), floatingAimIndex and the nested AimUIState.selectedIncomingIndex chains with one cursor row key per list, e.g. the aimId path. Derive the selection path from it; move-actions (J/K/H/L, x/p) and restore/persist use the same key. Should be decided together with the phase selection model question (focused entry + derived path + children remembered by id, explicit scroll intents); see 98f05e67.

status.comment: Waiting on Felix's decision about the overall selection model (asked 2026-09-29, alongside the phase auto-scroll fix): a single focused entry with derived path vs. the current per-column/per-level state.
